Stick Fight

Ten chalk fighters, each with a special skill. First to win two rounds takes the match.

Player 1 wins

Paused

Controls

A D or ← →
move
W or ↑
jump (press again in the air to double jump)
S or ↓
block
F G or K L
punch, kick
H or J
skill

How it plays

Punch
7 damage, fast
Kick
11 damage, longer reach, slower
Skill
each fighter's special; the gold meter under health shows when it is ready
Block
cuts damage to 15% if you face the hit
Timer
60s; more health wins at time out
